question: Two trains 259 m and 431 m long are running in opposite directions at a speed of 52 km/h and 56 km/h, respectively. They cross each other in:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative Speed (Opposite directions) = 52 + 56 = 108 km/h

Relative Speed in m/s = 108 × (5 ÷ 18) = 30 m/s

Total Distance to cross = 259 + 431 = 690 m

Time = 690 ÷ 30 = 23 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 23 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of 1st train (L₁) = 259 m

Speed of 1st train (S₁) = 52 km/h

Length of 2ⁿd train (L₂) = 431 m

Speed of 2ⁿd train (S₂) = 56 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed for opposite directions = S₁ + S₂

Time = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

Convert km/h to m/s by multiplying with (5 ÷ 18)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = L₁ + L₂

⇒ Total Distance = 259 + 431 = 690 m

⇒ Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂

⇒ Relative Speed = 52 + 56 = 108 km/h

⇒ Convert speed to m/s = 108 × (5 ÷ 18) = 30 m/s

⇒ Time taken = 690 ÷ 30

⇒ Time taken = 23 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 23 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Opposite Directions

When two objects move towards each other (in opposite directions), their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds: SR = S₁ + S₂.

Relative Speed in Same Direction

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference between their individual speeds: SR = |S₁ − S₂|.

Distance While Crossing

When two trains cross each other, the total distance covered is always equal to the sum of their lengths, regardless of the direction of their movement.

Unit Conversion Rule

To convert a speed from km/h to m/s, multiply the value by 5 ÷ 18. Conversely, to convert from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18 ÷ 5.
